_comment: #3145 parity vector. The Overview shows the SAME return twice: the 'autonomous_' KPI card takes it from the engine (perf_metrics.compute_cashflow_adjusted_returns) and the hero/chart computes it in the console (shared/twr.ts chainLink). Both must produce expected_twr_pct for this curve — the real live shape: a settlement-lagged deposit dated one point early, then normal days. The two money figures differ by design and by exactly funding_costs: the engine excludes a transfer fee from strategy P&L (#3049), the console's hero delta reports the raw market move. The console receives 'effective_cashflows' on the points (api_routes._return_metrics_from_points writes them back), NOT the gross 'cashflows' — that is what makes the two implementations arrive at the identical percentage.
